copy.text: Personalised coaching for those who want direct access and real accountability.
Weekly sessions, a personalised plan, and a coach who's fully in your corner.
Full programming and check-ins wherever you train. No gym required.
Practical eating plans that fit your life — not a crash diet.
We talk about your goals, your history, and whether we're the right fit.
I build a training and nutrition plan around your schedule and goals.
Weekly check-ins, regular plan updates, real progress — no guesswork.
Coaching built on results, not promises
I've been in the industry for 8 years. I've worked with everyone from beginners to competitive athletes. I take on a small number of clients so I can give each one my full attention.
Lost 14kg in 4 months and didn't have to give up a social life. Best investment I've made in myself.
Finally understood what I was doing wrong in the gym. Six months later I'm stronger than I've ever been.
Online coaching was the only thing that fit around my schedule. Genuinely life-changing.
Book your free 30-minute intro call. No pressure, no commitment.

build_notes.layout: full-bleed sections with centered max-width content container (max-w-7xl)
build_notes.style: premium fitness — dark, editorial, high contrast
build_notes.grid: CSS Grid with 12-column base; flex for nav and stat bar
notes: Background alternates between #0a0a0a (main sections) and #111111 (inset sections)
Accent color #e63946 used for CTAs, step numbers, stat callouts, and the final CTA band
All section padding: py-24 on desktop, py-16 on mobile
Cards use 1px border at rgba(255,255,255,0.08) with subtle hover lift (translateY -2px)
Hero image has slight gradient overlay on left edge to blend into text column
Typography: hero headline ~80px desktop / 48px mobile, section headlines 40px / 28px mobile
CTA buttons: primary = accent fill, secondary = white bordered ghost
Mobile: sections stack to single column, nav collapses to hamburger
